mainEntity.name: How much does a Hyundai i30 1.4-1.6 GDI Petrol engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reconditioned or rebuilt engine for the Hyundai i30 1.4-1.6 GDI Petrol typically ranges from £1,800 to £3,500 for supply only, depending on the specific engine code (G4FC, G4FD, or G4LD) and condition.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of HPFP failure in a Hyundai i30 GDI Petrol?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early signs include hard starting, engine misfires, loss of power under load, and an illuminated check engine light.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Hyundai i30 1.4-1.6 GDI Petrol?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the vehicle is in good overall condition. A rebuilt engine restores reliability and is often more cost-effective than purchasing a new vehicle.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Hyundai i30 1.4-1.6 GDI Petrol engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for the G4FC/G4LD engine typically takes 2 to 4 days.

mainEntity.name: Do Hyundai GDI engines need special maintenance to prevent failure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Direct injection engines are prone to carbon buildup on the intake valves. Regular intake valve cleaning (walnut blasting) every 40,000 miles is highly recommended.

problems.h4: Carbon Buildup & HPFP Wear - Why the Hyundai i30 1.4-1.6 GDI Petrol Loses Performance
problems.affectedModels: Hyundai i30 1.4-1.6 GDI Petrol (G4FC, G4FD, G4LD, 2012-2017)
problems.rootCause: Direct injection sprays fuel directly into the cylinder, bypassing the intake valves. This prevents fuel from washing away oil and carbon deposits, leading to severe intake valve coking and high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) wear over time.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Intake valve decarbonisation, HPFP inspection/replacement, and fuel system flush.
repairOptions.longevity: Suitable for early-stage rough idle or mild power loss.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt unit with upgraded components, new fuel system calibration, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Required if HPFP failure has sent metal debris through the fuel system or severe internal scoring has occurred.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Hyundai i30 1.4-1.6 GDI Petrol (GD generation) is worth £3,000-£7,000 `[THIRD-PARTY]`. At this value, a rebuilt engine replacement cost may represent 40-60% of the vehicle's value. Carefully evaluate the car's overall condition; if the chassis and interior are sound, replacement is viable, but for lower-value examples, a high-quality used engine may be more economical.
problems.recommendation: For isolated carbon buildup or minor HPFP issues, a specialist clean and component replacement is cost-effective. However, if the engine has suffered catastrophic HPFP failure with fuel system contamination, a fully rebuilt unit with upgraded components is the only reliable solution.

items.answer: Early signs include hard starting, engine misfires, loss of power under load, and an illuminated check engine light.

Ignoring these signs can lead to catastrophic internal engine damage.

Using high-quality, low-ash synthetic oil and adhering to strict service intervals will significantly prolong engine life.
